== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Harvest (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-155E-Harvest.png]]), the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-harvest-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip (2013) show the original words (see [[Harvest (V)]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html); 11 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. The list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “USED: Retrieve a device, or ▲ a device. (Immune to Sense.) STARTING: If your starting location was a Tatooine location, ▼ a farm, two devices, and two Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch R8-U run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
